description_raw: This dataset includes WIC households enrolled during state fiscal year (SFY) 2025 located in counties and municipalities with populations greater than 1,000 inhabitants. The total value of benefits redeemed by each household is aggregated for SFY 2025. Population values may be blank if a household does not fall within a municipality with a population greater than 1,000 inhabitants per United States Census Bureau data. Municipality names may be blank if a household does not fall within a municipal boundary or a census-designated place. County fields may be blank if the household does not fall within a municipal boundary as defined by the United States Census Bureau.
